thread:
tess: Just tried the Console quickstart after an SSO invite. Paste key, click 'Run' — UI shows 'Initializing...' forever, no error. Anyone?

/devex-bot: infra-check: quickstart instance healthy. No 5xx in logs.

rory: Can you curl the API with your key and paste status+body? Is it a user token or service key?

/tess: curl: HTTP/1.1 402
Body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"Workspace ws_tess requires billing activation"}
Browser console: TypeError: Failed to fetch -> spinner never stops.

karen: 402 means billing not enabled for the workspace. We've seen invited/SSO-provisioned orgs where the Console's billing CTA doesn't render. Also we have two legacy error codes payment_required vs billing_required which confuses clients.

rory: The quickstart client is currently set to retry on almost all errors, including 4xx. That causes the infinite spinner. Short-term fix: generate a service key from Org -> API keys and use it in the quickstart, it bypasses the billing gate for tests.

tess: Service key worked, got 200 and the quickstart printed the response.

/devex-bot: ticket DEVEX-612 created: "quickstart: stop retrying on 4xx; surface billing modal for payment/billing_required"

karen: Plan: normalize API to emit billing_required; add gateway shim to map payment_required->billing_required; patch SDKs to expose BillingRequiredError; update quickstart to check for both codes and show a modal instead of retrying. Example: `if (body.error === 'billing_required' || body.error === 'payment_required') { showBillingModal(body.message); return; }`

rory: I'll open PRs: quickstart fix, SDK error mapping, gateway rewrite. Also adding telemetry event quickstart.billing_blocked with error_variant.

karen: UX task UX-303 to ensure Console shows a 'Complete billing setup' CTA for invited/SSO orgs when billing_enabled: false and user has admin role. CTA should link to Org -> Billing and mention service key workaround.

tess: Thanks — happy to verify. :tada:
